### God's Lovely Dwelling Place
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-lovely-dwelling-place
Passage: Psalm 84:1-7
Points:
- Believers demonstrate their true devotion to God through a deep longing to dwell in His presence.
- The ancient sanctuary was beautiful primarily because the holy God chose to dwell there, not merely because of physical materials.
- Just as humble sparrows find a home near God's altars, the lowliest person is welcomed before Him.
- Sinners are made fit to dwell in God's radiant presence solely through the righteousness of Christ.
- Earthly pleasures pale beside the supreme beauty of God, which believers will one day behold face-to-face.

### Can We Experience "Better is One Day in Your Courts" Today or Only in Heaven?
Author: G. Connor Salter
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/better-is-one-day-in-your-courts-meaning.html
Passage: Psalm 84:10
Points:
- Spending time in the Lord's presence re-centers our hearts and directs our daily conduct.
- Lowly service in God's house is infinitely superior to enjoying comfort in sinful surroundings.
- Faithful service using our ordinary God-given abilities carries eternal kingdom value.
- Trusting that God's presence is best protects believers from harmful comparison and envy.
- Serving the Lord brings lasting spiritual blessing and heavenly reward, regardless of earthly status.
